pkgmetadata.longdescription: frp-mini is a lightweight Rust reimplementation of the frp reverse proxy (frpc client / frps server) using about 6 MB of memory. It supports TCP, UDP, HTTP, HTTPS, TCPMux, STCP and SUDP proxies over TCP, yamux or QUIC transports, adds IP allowlists and a web dashboard. Upstream only publishes prebuilt static binaries.
